workarounds.symptom: [FEATURE] Expose Home Assistant 2026.11 composed entity names instead of legacy friendly_name
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: name entities in search and the overview as Home Assistant shows them. Target files: custom_components/ha_mcp_tools/websocket_api/constants.py, custom_components/ha_mcp_tools/websocket_api/overview.py, custom_components/ha_mcp_tools/websocket_api/registry.py. Since Home Assistant 2026.11 the UI builds an entity's name from its parent device, device and entity names; `friendly_name` is the legacy name and can differ. `ha_search` matched and showed only `friendly_name`, so a search for the name on screen found not... (Ref: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/pull/3049)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] ha_set_zone: icon is not written to the zone storage collection (frontend shows no icon / empty Symbol field)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: store zone and helper icons where Core keeps them. Target files: src/ha_mcp/backup_entity_ids.py, src/ha_mcp/backup_zones.py, src/ha_mcp/tools/config_helpers/core_payload.py. . Part of #2632 (`ha_get_zone`, `ha_set_zone`, and the icon routing they share with `ha_config_set_helper`). (Ref: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/pull/3034)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] redact_secrets doesn't redact password fields in config/reconfigure flow forms returned by ha_set_integration
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(redaction): redact flow fields Core marks secret. Target files: src/ha_mcp/config_settings.py, src/ha_mcp/redaction.py, src/ha_mcp/tools/config_helpers/describe.py. Since Home Assistant 2026.11, integrations mark a secret config-flow field with `probatio.Secret(...)`, which Core serializes as `"secret": true` on a plain string field. `redact_secrets` only recognised a password text selector or `type: "password"`, so with the flag on, a reconfigure or options form returned the stored credential of every integratio... (Ref: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/pull/3010)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Marketplace (HA 2026.11): ha-mcp and ha-mcp-integration both claim ha_mcp_tools, update to v9.1.1 blocked from both entries
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(hacs): keep HA-MCP on one store listing and repair installs that got two. Target files: custom_components/ha_mcp_tools/const.py, custom_components/ha_mcp_tools/entry_device.py, custom_components/ha_mcp_tools/repairs.py. Two store listings carry the `ha_mcp_tools` integration: the main repository in the default catalog and the legacy distribution mirror earlier installs came from. The server's install hint named the main repository, and on HACS (Home Assistant 2026.10 and older) a download of it landed on top of a... (Ref: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/pull/2994)

workarounds.symptom: [FEATURE] Support entity_id as an alias for identifier in ha_config_get_automation and ha_config_set_automation
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: keep a renamed parameter callable and name a stale tool list when a tool rejects an unknown parameter. Target files: site/src/scripts/setup-wizard/instructions.js, site/src/scripts/setup-wizard/ui-clients.js, src/ha_mcp/renamed_tools.py. 9.1.0 renamed the automation tools' `identifier` parameter to `entity_id` (#2924). A client that still holds the tool list from before the update keeps sending `identifier`; the server rejected it, and the agent took that for a server bug (#2968, #2978). (Ref: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/pull/2979)
